Overnight the pound slid from 1.31161 to 1.30774, below the Asia low and below last week's low 1.30798. The dollar did the opposite and rose into a 4-hour area where sellers stepped in before.

London often opens by pushing one more time in the overnight direction, then turns. We wait for that last push down to fail: a 5-minute candle closing back above 1.30797. If the pound closes below 1.30540 instead, we stand aside.

  • Dollar: synthetic DXY 104.072, above its open 103.990 and in its 1h/4H bear FVG 104.102-104.127 (today's high 104.102). 20-day position 0.86, premium.

In plain English

Since 07:00 the pound has stepped lower all morning and is now at the day's low, 1.30581. The dollar sat still, so sellers are hitting the pound itself.

When a move is this one-sided, the first small bounce is usually where sellers come back. We wait for price to bounce into 1.30658-1.30668 and sell there. A close back above 1.30723 tells us the move is over.

In plain English

The pound fell 30 pips this morning and now sits on a 4-hour support area (1.30516-1.30774). The dollar did not move, so this was pound selling, and it is stretched: the pound is in the bottom 10% of its 20-day range.

At 13:30 the US releases GDP, inflation (core PCE), durable goods and jobless claims together. These often fake one way first. If the data pushes the pound under 1.30540 and it snaps back above 1.30565, we buy. A 15-minute close below 1.30516 means sellers are still in control: no trade.

The trader's view

  • Dollar: synthetic DXY 104.018, above its open 103.990, London range 103.971-104.090; its 1h/4H bear FVG 104.102-104.127 is untouched. A data spike into it that fails is the confirmation.
  • Which pair: pound weakest (GBP -0.25%, EUR -0.08% since the open; EUR/GBP 0.83760 near its high). EUR/USD held its London low 1.09316: SMT, the euro refused to follow the pound lower.
  • News: 13:30 USD GDP, core PCE, durables, claims (red). 15:00 new home sales. US Thanksgiving tomorrow: thin liquidity after 16:00.

ICT breakdown

  • Bias: reversal long from discount: GU 20-day position 0.10; London ran sell-side into the 4H bull FVG.
  • Model: News Judas: expect the 13:30 run to take sell-side under the 1h bull FVG 1.30540 into the 4H FVG base 1.30516, then a CISD close back above 1.30565.
  • DOL: 30m bear FVG 1.30667-1.30693, then 1.30774, with London's equilibrium 1.30723 in between. No OTE leg on the buy side yet.
  • London: trend day down on pound weakness, high 1.30865 07:15, low 1.30565 11:45; both desk calls stopped. Week: dollar-bearish lean, unconfirmed.
